steps.title: Fold corner to corner into a triangle
steps.check_question: Is the paper folded into a single triangle with three corners?
steps.common_mistake: Line up the two corners exactly before pressing the crease.

steps.title: Unfold and fold the other diagonal
steps.check_question: Is the paper a single triangle with one crease running from the top point to the bottom edge?
steps.common_mistake: Open the first fold, then bring the other pair of corners together.

steps.title: Unfold and fold edge to edge into a rectangle
steps.check_question: Is the paper folded into a rectangle with four corners and one long folded edge?
steps.common_mistake: Match the opposite edges before pressing the straight crease.

steps.title: Unfold, fold in half the other way, and reopen
steps.common_mistake: Turn the fold a quarter turn before pressing the second straight crease.

steps.title: Fold all four corners to the center
steps.check_question: Do four triangular flaps form a square with all four points meeting at the center?
steps.common_mistake: Bring every corner point to the exact center without gaps.

steps.title: Flip the folded square over
steps.check_question: Is the top a square with no triangular flap seams facing up?
steps.common_mistake: Flip it over first. The seams should face down.

steps.title: Fold all four corners to the center again
steps.check_question: Do four triangular flaps form a smaller square with all four points meeting at the center?
steps.common_mistake: Bring each corner to the center on this side and keep all four points touching.

steps.title: Crease the small square in half both ways
steps.common_mistake: Make both half-folds through the center, not along a diagonal.

steps.title: Open the four pockets into a fortune teller
steps.check_question: Does the paper stand as four pointed pockets meeting at the center?
steps.common_mistake: Slide one finger under each flap, then push all four pockets toward the center.
